meta.title: Dashboard - Ozoxy Partner Portal
meta.description: Status-aware operating surface for onboarding, review, inbox, cases, and readiness gating.

title: OZOXY PARTNER PORTAL
subtitle: PP2 turns the shell into a state-aware applicant workspace: review requests, inbox events, limited-access modules, and explainable blocked states now move together.

scenario.label: Local review scenario
scenario.description: Until backend review APIs arrive, this simulator drives the current workspace status, menu visibility, inbox content, and applicant-safe surface behavior.
scenario.helper: Use it to validate draft, needs-info, review, waitlist, probation, active, and restricted behavior in one portal shell.
scenario.canonicalDisabled: Scenario simulation is disabled while canonical workspace data is active.

role.label: Workspace role simulator
role.description: PP3 adds role-aware gating. Switch the current workspace role to verify menu access, section access, and route behavior for the launch role set.
role.helper: The selected role updates the sidebar, direct route access, and the new team/programs/legal surfaces.
role.canonicalDisabled: Workspace role now follows backend permissions for the active portal workspace.

releaseRing.label: Portal release ring
releaseRing.description: PP7 adds rollout gating. Switch the current release band to verify that modules stay closed until the intended launch ring opens.
releaseRing.helper: Use R1 for applicant and probation-safe launch, R2 for Creator / Affiliate launch, R3 for Performance rollout, and R4 for Reseller / API rollout.

workspaceStatus.title: WORKSPACE STATUS
workspaceStatus.description: Home, menu visibility, and direct-route posture all follow the same workspace band.

pendingTasks.title: PENDING TASKS
pendingTasks.description: Requested info and readiness blockers are now surfaced as first-class partner tasks.

notifications.title: INBOX SIGNALS
notifications.description: Unread portal notifications expose the latest ops, review, and governance signals.

cases.title: OPEN CASES
cases.description: Support and review threads stay visible even before operational launch.

vpnServiceStatus.title: Remnawave service status
vpnServiceStatus.description: Workspace-scoped availability, an inspectable grant inventory, and narrowly allowlisted controls for exact assigned VPN resources. Node topology, SSH, provider config, and customer credentials are never exposed here.
vpnServiceStatus.empty: Select an active partner workspace to view its VPN service status.
vpnServiceStatus.assignedResourcesHint: Aggregate resources assigned to this workspace; infrastructure topology remains private.

workspaceError.title: Workspace list is unavailable
workspaceError.description: The service status cannot be scoped until the active workspace is loaded.

permission.title: VPN status permission required
permission.description: Your current workspace role does not include remnawave_read. No service-status request was sent.

forbidden.title: Workspace access denied
forbidden.description: The server rejected this workspace-scoped status request. Ask a workspace owner to review your role or object grants.

error.title: VPN service status is unavailable
error.description: Other partner workflows remain available. Retry this read-only workspace snapshot.

degraded.title: VPN service is partially degraded
degraded.description: One or more workspace-safe capabilities are delayed or unavailable. Customer entitlements and control-plane telemetry are evaluated separately.

resources.title: Assigned Remnawave resources
resources.description: Inspect only active object grants for this workspace. Exact profile and integration grants can advertise narrow audited writes; all other provider mutations remain unavailable.
resources.empty: No readable Remnawave resources are assigned to this workspace.
resources.safeMutationsAvailable: This exact assignment advertises a narrow audited write. Inspect it to verify the effective role and object grant before editing.
resources.mutationsUnavailable: Generic provider mutations are unavailable. A node assignment can expose the separately audited connections control below.
resources.count: {count, plural, one {# assigned resource} other {# assigned resources}}
resources.providerDetailsPrivate: Provider payloads, topology, tokens, credentials, and integration identifiers remain private.

error.title: Resource inventory is unavailable
error.description: The workspace status remains visible. Retry the bounded, grant-scoped inventory request.

detailError.title: Assignment is no longer available
detailError.description: The resource may have been revoked or moved. Refresh the inventory before trying again.

safeMutations.secureUuidUnavailable: This browser cannot create the secure one-time request identifier, so no mutation was sent.

permission.title: Scoped write permission required
permission.description: No mutation control is exposed unless remnawave_write is active in the workspace role and this exact object grant advertises the matching safe mutation.

profile.title: Replace profile tags
profile.description: Set the complete tag list for this exact granted profile. This control cannot change the profile body, topology, squads, snippets, or provider config.
profile.label: Complete tag list
profile.help: Use up to 10 unique comma-separated tags containing only A-Z, 0-9, underscore, or colon. Leave empty only when you intend to clear every tag.

validation.tooMany: A profile can receive at most 10 tags in this operation.
validation.format: Every tag must contain 1-36 characters using only A-Z, 0-9, underscore, or colon.

integration.title: Update integration metadata
integration.description: Change only the display name or description for this exact granted integration. Credentials, config, restart controls, nodes, and topology remain unavailable.
integration.help: Omitted fields remain unchanged. Name must contain 2-30 characters; description is limited to 255 characters.

validation.required: Enter a name, a description, or explicitly clear the description.
validation.name: The name must contain 2-30 characters.

success.title: Scoped mutation confirmed
success.completed: CyberVPN verified the exact provider response and refreshed the authoritative workspace assignment.
success.accepted: This idempotent attempt was already accepted. CyberVPN refreshed the authoritative workspace assignment without issuing a different mutation.

reconciliation.title: Mutation requires reconciliation
reconciliation.description: The provider outcome could not be proven. The form is locked and CyberVPN will not send a new mutation; an administrator must reconcile the durable attempt.

forbidden.title: Scoped write access was denied
forbidden.description: The active role or exact object grant no longer permits this mutation. Refresh the assignment after an owner reviews access.

notFound.title: The assignment is no longer available
notFound.description: The grant or provider resource may have been revoked. Refresh the inventory before taking another action.

conflict.title: Mutation attempt conflict
conflict.description: The server rejected conflicting idempotency state. Do not send a different payload with this attempt.

invalid.title: Mutation input was rejected
invalid.description: CyberVPN rejected the bounded metadata or tag payload before a safe provider result was confirmed.

provider.title: Provider outcome was not confirmed
provider.description: The request may already have reached CyberVPN or Remnawave. Only a manual replay with the same idempotency key is safe.

unknown.title: Browser did not receive a mutation result
unknown.description: The request may already have reached CyberVPN. No automatic retry occurred; only a manual replay with the same idempotency key is safe.

connections.title: Scoped node connections
connections.description: Request a fresh aggregate for this exact assigned node. Individual addresses, users, topology, integration identifiers, tokens, and credentials are never returned to this view.
connections.empty: No connection snapshot has been requested for this node.
connections.requestingStatus: Creating a scoped connection snapshot request
connections.capabilityUnavailable: Connection snapshots are unavailable in the current workspace service status. Refresh the status before trying this control.
connections.polling: The snapshot is processing. This view will poll only its opaque request receipt.
connections.noActiveConnections: No active connections were reported for this node.
connections.privacy: Only aggregate connection counts and the latest activity time are displayed. Browser SSH is never available to partners.

jobFailed.title: Connection snapshot failed
jobFailed.description: Remnawave did not complete this read job. Request a new scoped snapshot; no mutation was performed.

forbidden.title: Connection access denied
forbidden.description: The active role or exact node grant no longer includes the required Remnawave permission.

notFound.title: Connection request is no longer available
notFound.description: The opaque request expired, the assignment was revoked, or the node is unavailable. Request a new snapshot after confirming the grant.

conflict.title: Request conflict
conflict.description: The server rejected conflicting request state. Start a new action instead of replaying a different payload.

invalidProvider.title: Remnawave response was rejected
invalidProvider.description: CyberVPN did not accept an invalid or rejected provider response. No provider details are shown here.

unavailable.title: Connections service is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: The scoped request registry or Remnawave connection service is unavailable. Retry without changing the target.

unknown.title: Connection request failed
unknown.description: The browser could not confirm the safe read request. Retry the same workspace and node.

drop.title: Drop service-identity connections
drop.description: Disconnect one opaque CyberVPN service identity from this exact assigned node. Numeric provider user IDs and IP-address targets are never accepted or shown here.
drop.permissionRequired: This action requires remnawave_execute in both the active workspace role and this exact node grant.
drop.snapshotRequired: Request a fresh snapshot before using execute controls so the server capability is explicit.
drop.serviceIdentityRequirement: The backend also requires an exact remnawave_execute grant for the chosen service identity and resolves its provider mapping server-side.
drop.serviceIdentityManualHint: If the grant is on another inventory page, enter its exact UUID. The backend rechecks the workspace and both object grants before any provider call.
drop.serviceIdentityUuidError: Select or enter a valid service-identity UUID.

accepted.title: Drop accepted
accepted.description: Remnawave accepted the single scoped command. Request a new aggregate snapshot to verify the resulting connection state.

outcomeUnknown.title: Drop outcome is unknown
outcomeUnknown.description: The command may already have reached Remnawave. It will not be retried, and this receipt forbids another send. Reconcile with a new aggregate snapshot.

clientOutcomeUnknown.title: Browser could not confirm the drop receipt
clientOutcomeUnknown.description: The request may have reached CyberVPN. Only a replay with the same idempotency key is safe; a new key could disconnect twice.

tasks.title: Pending tasks
tasks.description: Applicant-facing work is now explicit: requested info, finance onboarding, and blocked-state explanations live here.

readiness.title: Readiness overlays
readiness.description: Finance, compliance, technical posture, and governance state are kept separate from the canonical workspace status.

constraints.title: Current constraints
constraints.description: Blocked, task-driven, limited, and read-only states are kept visible before the partner opens a section.
constraints.empty: No active constraints are limiting the current workspace view.
constraints.canonicalReasonDescription: Partner ops has marked this workspace as constrained. Open the linked section for the current response path.
constraints.releaseRingDescription: {count} section(s) are held until a later release ring opens.
constraints.taskDescription: {count} section(s) require partner action before the workspace can move forward.
constraints.limitedDescription: {count} section(s) are visible with constrained workflow depth.
constraints.readOnlyDescription: {count} section(s) are visible for reference while writes remain unavailable.

sections.title: Visible sections
sections.description: The sidebar and direct routes now follow the same visibility matrix.

main.title: Overview
main.description: Current posture, alerts, and urgent actions.

onboarding.title: Start
onboarding.description: Identity, organization, terms, and review inputs.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: People, role posture, preferences, and workspace security.

promotion.title: Programs & Promotion
promotion.description: Lanes, links, codes, campaigns, and approved materials.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Statements, payout readiness, holds, and account posture.

control.title: Control & Support
control.description: Compliance tasks, disputes, requested info, and support workflow.

technical.title: Integrations
technical.description: Tokens, postbacks, delivery logs, storefront, and voucher scope.

stateDescriptions.hidden: This section is not shown in the current lifecycle state.
stateDescriptions.read: Data is visible for reference while write actions stay disabled.
stateDescriptions.task: This section has an action-required workflow for the current lifecycle band.
stateDescriptions.limited: This section is available with limited workflow depth until the workspace advances.
stateDescriptions.full: This section is fully available for the current role and lifecycle state.

rollout.title: Rollout readiness
rollout.description: Release-ring gating prevents modules from leaking ahead of the intended launch band.
rollout.empty: No additional modules are being held back by the current release ring.

performanceSnapshot.title: Performance Snapshot
performanceSnapshot.description: PP5 pulls core reporting signals onto the dashboard so analytics and export posture become visible before deeper conversion surfaces land.

financeSnapshot.title: Finance Snapshot
financeSnapshot.description: Finance readiness, reserves, and payout forecast now have a dedicated dashboard summary instead of hiding behind later settlement screens.

nextActions.title: Next actions
nextActions.description: Use the applicant-safe surfaces to continue the review loop: update the application, respond to partner ops, and inspect inbox changes.
